# The double-read agreement, pooled — generated by `scripts/double_read_agreement.py`

*10 batch(es), 216 independently double-read (key, reader-pair) cells over 115 distinct keys and 4 reader pair(s).  Pooled raw agreement **62.5%**, pooled Cohen's kappa **+0.43**.  Between-batch variance (DerSimonian–Laird) tau² = 0.0327; the size at which one more ~23-key batch moves the pooled share by more than 5 points with under 5% probability is **n\* = 164** keys (PREDICTION.md's rule, recomputed from the batches so far) — NOT YET: 49 keys to go, counted in DISTINCT keys and not in cells -- the rule was registered in keys, and three readings of one key are not three independent samples when the disagreement is a property of the key (r7297).*
